visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a brown polo shirt and white trousers walks confidently on a vast, sandy beach under a bright, sunny sky. Tiny waves gently crash on the shore to his right. In the background, modern city buildings and mountains are visible under a clear atmosphere. He then leans against large, white three-dimensional letters spelling 'DANANG' under the shade of palm trees. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a market, where the same man, now carrying a black backpack, interacts with a female vendor. The environment is dense with shelves stocked with packaged foods, coffee boxes, and hanging jewelry. The lighting is warm and indoor. He gestures towards the products while the vendor looks on and speaks. (3) Outside on a busy city street, the man and a woman walk across a wide zebra crossing. Numerous motorbikes and cars zip past them. The woman wears a beige jacket and a blue skirt. The camera captures them from various angles, including eye-level and POV shots showing the lack of traffic signals. (4) During the night, the couple sits on a small wooden boat decorated with colorful lanterns on a dark river. The man hands a bouquet of white flowers to the woman, who holds her smartphone to record or photograph the moment. Finally, the man speaks directly to the camera in a close-up shot, his facial expressions focused and serious as he explains a point.
